correctness.rationale: Prime-power occurrence sets are precisely sets of multiples of divisibility-chain ranks. The exact floor-carry formula proves integrality. For each prime and row, the maximal proper rank dividing the row index (or 1) simultaneously eliminates all non-n rank carries, proving the exact minimum. The same ranks count first appearance of prime-power levels in prefix lcm, and Nowicki proves the Möbius factorization. The boundary n=2 and non-normalized U_1 are included. Exact integers were independently checked via the attached verifier; finite tests are not claimed to prove universal quantification.

value.rationale: The full-row gcd is a canonical arithmetic invariant of generalized Pascal arrays, not a parameter-arbitrary numerical slice. The universal equality identifies it with the exact first-appearance increment of the underlying sequence lcm, and produces explicit prime-adic sharpness witnesses. It simultaneously organizes the prime-power ordinary binomial criterion, the previously known Fibonacci primitive-factor sequence, and Gaussian cyclotomic values without claiming those special values as new. This is a structural all-indices theorem applicable beyond linear recurrence sequences, rather than a table recomputation or cosmetic restatement.
